instruction: Create packages/web/src/grid/interaction/math/all-day.create.ts — a NEW pure module with no React, no store and no DOM access. Export exactly the three symbols specified in change_plan.md §5: interface AllDayCreateRange { startDate: string; endDate: string } (both YEAR_MONTH_DAY_FORMAT; endDate is EXCLUSIVE — the last dragged day plus one); resolveAllDayCreateRange(anchorDate: string, pointerDate: string): AllDayCreateRange which normalises so startDate = min(anchor, pointer) and endDate = max(anchor, pointer) + 1 day; and isSameAllDayCreateRange(a: AllDayCreateRange | null, b: AllDayCreateRange): boolean where a null `a` is never equal. Use dayjs from @core/util/date/dayjs and YEAR_MONTH_DAY_FORMAT from @core/constants/date.constants. resolveAllDayCreateRange(d, d) MUST return { startDate: d, endDate: dayjs(d).add(1,'day').format(YEAR_MONTH_DAY_FORMAT) } — byte-equal to today's one-day behaviour. Pure and idempotent: branch only on the two arguments, never on computed output. Include the TSDoc comments from §5. No barrel file.

instruction: Add a new section 'Drag-to-create in the all-day row' to docs/frontend/week-drag-interaction.md. Document: the gesture lifecycle (capture-phase window mousemove/mouseup plus blur, threshold, live preview via startGridDraft activity 'creating' then setGridDraft, terminal handoff); the clientY pin and WHY it exists — useGridCoordinates.getDateByXY adds getMinuteByY(y) minutes to the column date and getMinuteByY floors at 0 but has no upper bound, so a pointer dragged well below the grid exceeds 1440 minutes and silently rolls the resolved date to the next day; the x-only threshold (feeding the pinned y makes dy identically 0 so the shared helper collapses to |dx| > t); and the exclusive-end all-day convention. Also record the D8 consequence: in Week, click-to-create now completes on mouseup rather than mousedown, and the form still opens because handleChange in packages/web/src/views/Week/components/Draft/hooks/actions/useDraftActions.ts (lines 369-383) calls setIsFormOpen(true) when activity === 'gridClick', re-run by the effect in packages/web/src/views/Week/components/Draft/hooks/effects/useDraftEffects.ts (lines 62-64).
